value.rationale: Radius two has exactly D independent observations to recover a degree<=2 Walsh polynomial and is the smallest feasible Hamming ball. Exact condition growth n^8/256 shows a severe stability cost at this natural information-theoretic sampling boundary; full-radius small blocks enable quantitative comparison without matrix sizes O(n^2).
